origin.description: Put every diffobj option back to its default. The help example is wrapped in dontrun, so this prints the call.
origin.details: The return value is what options() gives back: the previous value of each diffobj option.
origin.value: A named list of the previous values.

translation.description: Reset the settings table and return the previous values.
translation.details: A name that was missing is None in the returned dict. After the call, gdo reads the defaults again.
translation.value: A dict of the previous values, keyed by the full diffobj. name.
translation.example:
from diffobj import diffobj_set_def_opts, gdo
from diffobj.options import settings
settings["diffobj.format"] = "raw"
old = diffobj_set_def_opts()
print(old["diffobj.format"], gdo("format"))
